## v1.3.0 — 2026-03-15

This release introduces significant API access control and monetization features, including dashboard API key gating, multiple pricing tiers, and free tier usage limits to better manage resource allocation and provide structured service offerings.

### ✨ Features

- Added API key gating to dashboard endpoints to control access and authentication.
- Implemented pricing tiers system to support different service levels and subscription models.
- Added free tier limits to manage resource usage and prevent abuse on free accounts.
